title: Discernment Gate v1 (Mechanical)
description: Seven-valence discernment of experience-moments. Wires the seven-valence mechanical ruleset to classify experience-moment attestation-write events and emit StoryPointTag verdicts. Three-node DAG: assemble → rules → synthesize. Implements spec §3.3 of 2026-04-18-experience-story-epr-design.md.
content:
# discernment-gate-v1-mechanical
# See gate-client/src/dag/discernment_gate_v1.yaml for the canonical embedded source.
# This seed entry makes the discernment gate discoverable as a ContentNode on the DHT.
#
# The authoritative YAML is embedded in the gate-client binary at compile time.
# This seed is a reference copy for DHT-based governance lookup (Phase 5+).
#
# Three-node DAG:
#   assemble (context-assemble)
#     └─ next ──► rules (mechanical-ruleset, rules_cid: epr:rules:seven-valence-v1)
#                     ├─ ruleDecision == null  ──► terminal: terminal-no-mint
#                     └─ ruleDecision != null  ──► synthesize (synthesize, Terminate)
#
# Context pre-computation contract (Task 3.4 must implement):
#   The context-assemble step must inject precomputed boolean fields:
#     priorAttestations.witnessEligible
#     priorAttestations.refinementEligible
#   before the mechanical-ruleset step runs.

name: "discernment-gate-v1-mechanical"
version: "1.0.0"
event_type: "attestation-write"

dag:
  entrypoint: "assemble"

  steps:
    assemble:
      type: "context-assemble"
      params:
        pulls:
          - from: "source-chain"
            query: "experience-moment.entry"
            output_key: "moment"
          - from: "elohim-storage"
            query: "prior-attestations.for-experience-story"
            output_key: "priorAttestations"
      next: "rules"

    rules:
      type: "mechanical-ruleset"
      params:
        rules_cid: "epr:rules:seven-valence-v1"
        input_keys:
          - "moment"
          - "priorAttestations"
        output_key: "ruleDecision"
      edges:
        - when: "ruleDecision == null"
          target: "terminal-no-mint"
        - when: "ruleDecision != null"
          target: "synthesize"

    synthesize:
      type: "synthesize"
      params:
        input_keys:
          - "ruleDecision"
          - "moment"
        decision_builder: "verdict-from-rule"
        side_effects:
          - type: "MintAttestation"
            params_from_keys:
              - "momentEntryHash"
              - "ruleDecision"
            shape: "StoryPointLink"
          - type: "EmitEconomicEvent"
            params_from_keys:
              - "ruleDecision"

  terminals:
    terminal-no-mint:
      decision:
        status: "allow"
        exempt: true
        rationale: "steady-state-silence"
      side_effects: []
